rv.q: Short's manic energy and dead-on impressions keep the audience in stitches, even when the material feels thin.
Short nonetheless delivers a good time.
The rhythm is quick, and Short's a pro whose singing has more suavity and power than the mockery suggests.
But, bless his heart, he has yet to find a show that lets him shine as he was meant to.
Everyone else ought to stay firmly put - they're the real reason to see Fame Becomes Me.
But as for Short, Fame doesn’t fully become him.

tn.cat: Best Featured Actor in a Musical

cn.t: Short's manic energy and sharp impressions entertain, but critics find the Broadway showcase amiably anarchic yet uneven, with material that often feels thin despite its self-aware satire of fame and musicals.
